💰Salary based on your experience and seniority level: 🇩🇰Up to 48,000 DKK (gross)

**About Monta

**Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people — sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You’ll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

We’re looking for a Mid Level Backend Engineer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves, take ownership, and build with us.

**This Is What You Will Achieve

**

• Power the #1 CPMS & EV charging Platform: Build the robust, scalable infrastructure necessary to make Monta the undisputed global leader in Charge Point Management Systems.

• Scale the Roaming Network: Strengthen our existing roaming functionality. Your work will directly impact how seamlessly thousands of EV drivers connect to charging points across different networks.

• Innovate on Standards: Implement exciting new features including the latest OCPI versions and Plug & Charge capabilities.

• Turn vision into reality: Balance technical ambition with sleeves-rolled-up execution to ensure our fleet and roaming offerings remain best-in-class.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Own the full lifecycle: Scope out requirements and plan new features in collaboration with the team, taking code from ideation to production.

• Cross-team execution: Work closely with Roaming Ops, Product, Frontend and other Backend teams to navigate ambiguity and ensure features integrate seamlessly.

• Ensure quality at speed: Perform automated validation and verification testing while supporting your teammates with thoughtful code reviews.

• Monitor and Maintain: Utilize tools like Grafana and Loki to monitor system health, ensuring reliability for the drivers who depend on us.

• Own outcomes in a high-trust environment where we value execution over perfection.

• Navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities keeping momentum when it matters most.

• Celebrate wins and learn fast from misses alongside an ambitious, diverse team.

• Push boundaries with courage and resilience while staying true to our DNA.

**A Brief Overview Of Our Tech Stack

**

• PHP/Laravel monolith

• Kotlin services with Micronaut and Exposed

• Dart/Flutter (incl. Flutter Web) for apps

• Typescript/React (+Next.js) for web apps and rapid prototyping

• Observability via Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenSearch/Kibana

• AWS + Kubernetes with Helm and Argo CD for deployments

What We’re Looking For

• Junior ready for the next jump or mid-level backend experience: You have experience building scalable backend systems.

• Tech Stack: You have worked in Kotlin (Micronaut) and PHP (Laravel), or have experience in one with the ability to quickly master the other in a mixed environment.

• Clear & pragmatic communicator who builds alignment fast.

• Authentic team player with empathy, openness, and ownership.

• Comfortable with AI-powered tools to accelerate your work (Claude, Gemini, Codex, etc.), with the willingness to learn more.

_If the mission excites you but your experience isn’t a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway - we care about potential, not perfection.

_**AI Competency

**You’ll be expected to work with AI-powered tools. Some we use:

• GitHub Copilot / Claude Code

• ChatGPT / Gemini / Claude

• Notion AI (docs, knowledge, meeting notes)

• AI-enhanced testing & monitoring (e.g., generative QA, Grafana ML)

_We don’t expect mastery of all, but we expect comfort with learning, experimenting, and adopting AI responsibly.

_Why Monta

• Ownership from day one — we don’t micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• Becoming number one is not easy — priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You’ll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life’s big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you’re at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you’ll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don’t accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won’t agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

**Job Description

**SOUNDBOKS is an innovative tech company and aspiring lifestyle brand. You may have seen us at a music festival, street party, or your friend’s celebration (think: private events combining festival-grade sound with beat-enhancing lights) where special moments are turned into memories. We create the loudest, most durable, and arguably coolest Bluetooth speakers and audio reactive lights on the market.

At SOUNDBOKS, trust and community go hand in hand. People are encouraged to take ownership of their work while knowing they have the support of the team behind them. Voices are heard, ideas are welcomed, and collaboration is what pushes us forward.

This is more than a job - it’s a community where people care about each other, celebrate together, and share the energy of creating something meaningful. Life at SOUNDBOKS is bold, fast, and full of passion - for the product, for the mission, and for showing up as your true self. With 70 team members, this is a place where you can do your best work and truly belong.

ROLE AUDIO ENGINEER

TEAM PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

HOURS FULL TIME

LOCATION COPENHAGEN, DENMARK

START DATE OCTOBER 2026 or ASAP

The Product Development team at SOUNDBOKS is the group responsible for the exciting product journey, taking every step of the development process toward and into mass production. In it’s heartbeat you’ll find collaborative and self-driven team members with a large cross-discipline understanding tied to ownership. They are there to make a difference - for the products, the team and the SOUNDBOKS customers as a whole.

As our Audio Engineer, you'll explore new ways to improve the audio experience across SOUNDBOKS products by combining signal processing, system simulation, and engineering insight. Working closely with the Acoustics, Hardware, and Firmware teams, you'll help shape the technologies behind our next generation of speakers.

Okay, let’s make things a little more concrete. Here’s what we expect your daily life to look like:

**Audio System Development

**

• Develop audio concepts and proof-of-concepts at a system level.

• Explore new approaches to improve audio performance across products.

• Collaborate with the Acoustics, Hardware, and Firmware teams during concept development.

**Signal Processing & Simulation

**

• Perform advanced signal processing simulations with a focus on sound pressure level (SPL), sound quality, and system efficiency.

• Simulate the interaction between acoustics, amplifiers, electronics, and battery performance.

• Evaluate and develop signal processing algorithms to improve overall product audio performance.

**System Performance & Collaboration

**

• Work closely across the entire Product Development team in order to evolve and improve the audio performance across our future product portfolio.

• Apply signal processing methodologies to improve sound pressure, sound quality, and battery performance.

**Job Requirements

****In order to become a success in this role, we believe that your profile should be aligned with the bullets listed below. However, we acknowledge that success can take many forms, so please do apply even if you don’t tick all the boxes.

**

• You hold a BSc or higher in Audio Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Acoustics, or a related engineering field.

• You've designed and simulated audio systems, ideally loudspeakers, and know your way around signal processing for audio.

• You're comfortable using simulations and measurements to test ideas, challenge assumptions, and make better engineering decisions.

• It’ll be considered a plus if you have experience working with loudspeaker design, transducers, enclosure design, or audio electronics.

• You get excited by solving difficult audio problems and finding smarter ways to improve performance.

• You're naturally curious, love experimenting, and enjoy digging into the details until things sound and work better.

• You take ownership of your work and enjoy bouncing ideas around with people who know more than you in their field.

• You're drawn to what SOUNDBOKS is building and are excited to be a part of the journey!

Intrigued? At SOUNDBOKS you’ll find yourself a part of a community. We realize that growth is a process and we don’t expect you to go through it alone. Actually, we guarantee that you won’t have to. We work together in order to work smarter, we inspire each other to be better, and we never forget that every member of the team is responsible for our success.

So, if you’re tired of all of the noise in the job market, we’d love to hear from you. This may be the coolest job you ever have.

**Job Description

**Are you driven by designing robust software architecture and solving complex system-level challenges in high-performance, real-time environments? Do you want to build systems that turn raw sensor data into precise and real-time metrics that golfers and broadcasters rely on?

At Trackman, we combine radar technology, computer vision, and data intelligence to redefine how golf is played, practiced and experienced. From local golf clubs to live TV broadcasts, our products set the global standard for accuracy, performance, and innovation.

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to play a central role in architecting and evolving the software systems behind Trackman Range and Golf Broadcast.

In this role, you will design and own key parts of our real-time data processing platform, ensuring it is scalable, maintainable, and performant under demanding conditions. You will work at the intersection of software engineering and applied algorithms, translating mathematical models and signal-processing concepts into robust, production-grade systems.

You will be responsible for system-level design decisions, improving software architecture, and driving engineering quality across the codebase. This includes diagnosing complex system behavior, addressing performance regressions, and ensuring high standards of reliability, testability, and maintainability.

**Job Requirements

****The Ideal Candidate Has

**

• A master’s degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field

• Strong expertise in C++ and Python, with a track record of building high-performance, production-grade systems

• Experience designing and owning scalable software architectures and real-time data processing pipelines

• Strong understanding of performance engineering, multi-threading, and system-level debugging (e.g., concurrency issues, performance regressions)

• Experience driving code quality, testing, CI/CD, and managing technical debt in production systems

• Experience with Linux-based systems for development, deployment, and debugging of distributed applications

• Experience with Docker for containerization and orchestration of those applications

• 5+ years of relevant experience with ownership of critical systems or components

**Other Valued Experience

**

• Radar technology, signal processing, numerical algorithms and sensor fusion

• Computer vision, tracking, and camera calibration

• Deep learning model implementation and optimization

• Real-time camera and video systems, including stream handling, data capture and encoding/decoding

• GPU acceleration and performance profiling

**The Office

**We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

**Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

**Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

**Where innovation happens

**At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

**Share our Passion!

**Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

**Location: Copenhagen (please note this job requires onsite presence - remote work not possible)

**Do you want to work hands-on with modern cloud-based technologies, data engineering and AI, while helping turn complex data into solutions that create real business value?

Join us as a Data Engineer to become part of an environment where knowledge is shared, and curiosity is encouraged. And work with tools such as Snowflake, dbt, Claude, Microsoft Azure, SQL and AI as you help develop the data platform that enables actionable insights, intelligent solutions and data-driven applications.

“You’ll get to contribute to solutions for a wide portfolio of customers - without compromising on flexibility and work-life balance. This also allows you to develop your expertise through challenging assignments and collaboration with experienced colleagues,” says Brian Landbo, Manager, SmartX.

**Join an environment built around knowledge, collaboration and growth

**At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we believe that development happens when people learn and solve challenges together. You will become part of our ambitious and agile SmartX team where the pace is high and where we work with modern cloud technologies, data engineering, analytics and AI through our data platform.

**Develop our cloud-based data platform

**As a Data Engineer, you will work closely with analysts, developers and business stakeholders, play a central role in developing our cloud-based data platform, and help transform complex data requirements into robust solutions that deliver real value. You will work across data engineering and AI, while contributing to the foundations that make intelligent and data-driven solutions possible.

**More Specifically, You Will

**

• Develop and maintain data models

• Develop, optimize and quality-assure data pipelines in Snowflake

• Implement transformations, tests and documentation using dbt

• Ensure high data quality through automated testing and validation processes

• Work with Medallion Architecture and modern data warehouse principles

• Support the development of AI-based solutions and data-driven applications

**Experience With The Main Technologies

**You do not need to tick every box. We believe some of the best colleagues grow through curiosity, commitment and a genuine desire to learn. We are looking for a new colleague who enjoys solving complex problems and who is motivated by both technology and the value it can create. You thrive in a collaborative environment where professional dialogue and knowledge sharing are an important part of everyday work. And you enjoy continuously learning and exploring new technologies within data, AI and cloud platforms.

**Finally, We Imagine That You

**

• Have hands-on experience with and a solid understanding of Snowflake as a cloud data warehouse

• Have strong SQL and data modelling skills, including experience with dimensional modelling such as facts, dimensions and star schemas

• Have experience using dbt for data transformation and ETL/ELT processes

• Have worked with data validation, automated testing and documentation

• Have experience with Git and agile development processes

**Ready to build what comes next?

**Then we are happy to hear from you and urge you to hit that “Apply Now“ button.

Apply today and make NTT DATA Business Solutions the place where you grow.

Develop high potential colleagues. Grow leaders. Build succession strength across SGL.

Are you ready to develop high potential people and strengthen leadership across SGL?

As Scan Global Logistics grows and evolves, we want to strengthen how we identify high potential (HiPo), develop leaders and prepare successors for critical roles. We are looking for someone who can turn these priorities into practical programmes and consistent follow-through across countries.

As Global P&C Manager within Development, your primary focus will be talent & HiPo management, to launch our internal development and leadership programmes, succession planning and 1:1 leadership development. You will also support the people aspects of acquisitions, while the Global Chief People & Culture Officer directly leads our people integration.

This is a role with two different rhythms: a planned cycle of HiPo reviews, planning and leadership development, alongside time-sensitive integration support. Development remain your core role and responsibility. During live transactions, you will agree specific support priorities with the Global Chief People & Culture Officer, making trade-offs explicit rather than allowing integration to absorb the role.

What you can expect

• Ownership of practical global HiPo and leadership development programmes, from design and planning to delivery, adoption and follow-up.

• Close collaboration with business leaders and regional and local P&C colleagues to connect development with real business needs.

• A clear core mandate spanning HiPo reviews, development and leadership programmes, succession planning, critical-role mapping and development actions.

• A complementary role in integration: supporting HiPo, retention and leadership alignment under the direct leadership of the Global Chief People & Culture Officer.

In your first year

In your first year, you will help establish a practical HiPo and succession cycle, shape and deliver on our programmes, and ensure that development conversations lead to action. You will also contribute to agreed integration assignments.

Development

• Establish a practical global review cycle with clear criteria, useful preparation and consistent follow-up across regions.

• Facilitate HiPo conversations with leaders and local P&C, translating identified needs into development plans and clear ownership.

• Create practical tools for development conversations, career planning and internal mobility, and support their adoption.

• Track agreed development actions and identify where additional support or decisions are needed.

Programmes and leadership development

• Shape and deliver on our programmes, connecting content with SGL’s business needs, culture and leadership priorities.

• Work with leaders, P&C colleagues and learning partners to organise learning journeys, facilitate sessions and support application in everyday work.

• Evaluate participation, feedback and practical application, and improve programmes based on what leaders and teams need.

Succession and critical-role planning

• Map critical roles and succession coverage with business leaders, identifying readiness gaps and development priorities.

• Facilitate succession discussions and agree concrete actions to strengthen the pipeline for business-critical roles.

• Connect succession plans with leadership development, internal mobility and retention priorities, keeping plans current and actionable.

Integration support

• Support HiPo mapping, critical-role retention and leadership alignment in acquired businesses under the direct leadership of the Global Chief People & Culture Officer.

• Contribute to agreed integration plans, leader communication and onboarding, coordinating with acquired leaders and local P&C colleagues.

• Support agreed people-integration actions, including coordination and harmonisation, alignment with legal, IT and local P&C.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for a hands-on and experienced P&C professional who can build practical programmes, facilitate meaningful conversations with senior leaders and ensure that development plans are implemented—not left in presentations.

• Relevant higher education within HR/P&C, organisational psychology, business, learning and development or a related field.

• At least 5 years of relevant experience in talent management, leadership development, succession planning or organisational development; experience supporting M&A integration is an advantage.

• Proven experience delivering talent reviews, succession planning or leadership development programmes from preparation through implementation and follow-up.

• Strong facilitation and programme management skills, with confidence engaging senior stakeholders and translating discussions into action.

• Ability to connect business priorities with talent pipelines, leadership capability, retention and practical development opportunities.

• Excellent written and spoken English; experience working across countries, cultures and regulatory environments.

What will make you successful

• You create clarity and momentum when information is incomplete and priorities change.

• You handle sensitive people matters with sound judgement, empathy and discretion.

• You balance global consistency with local relevance, and make explicit choices when development priorities and integration support compete.

• You connect strategy with disciplined execution and make sure decisions become action.

• You build trust through practical support and measure progress by stronger succession coverage, implemented development actions and application of learning.

Why join Scan Global Logistics?

At SGL, you will join an international logistics company with an entrepreneurial culture, high ambitions and a strong belief that results are created by people who take responsibility. Our DNA is built on Respect, Integrity, Entrepreneurship & Fun.

You will have the opportunity to shape how SGL develops talent and leaders, strengthens succession and gives colleagues room to grow—while supporting the talent and leadership side of integration.

Interested?

Send your CV and application through the SGL career portal. We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the process when the right candidate has been found.

For further information, please contact Birgitte Dam, Global Chief People & Culture Officer (+45 7872 5403) or visit www.scangl.com.

Highlights

• Full-Stack Python/TS engineer needed for a B2B SaaS startup in Copenhagen (with plenty of traction!)

• We have a lean, get-stuff-done team. No annoying extra management layers or unnecessary bureaucratic rituals. And we are "AI-forward" in our own development practices.

• You will own features end to end, from the data model through to the screen, on a platform that manufacturers rely on to keep production lines running.

• You will work in a small engineering team, directly with the person who decides what we build, and the problems you spend your time on are hard because the domain is hard, not because the organization is.

• We're building legitimately useful tools for the industries and companies that make the world go around.... manufacturers. Both AI-tools and just "plain-old-good-software" tools.

About Supplios

Manufacturers live or die by their supply base. Sourcing the wrong supplier, onboarding one slowly, failing to qualify one properly or losing track of a non-conformance can stop a production line and cost millions. Yet most manufacturers still run these relationships across email chains, spreadsheets and shared drives.

Supplios is a supplier collaboration platform for manufacturers in automotive and industrial sectors. We cover the full supplier relationship: sourcing, onboarding, qualification, day-to-day collaboration, compliance and supplier quality, all in a modern cloud based platform that is easy for manufacturers to implement and operate. It is built specifically for the way automotive and industrial manufacturers actually work.

We are headquartered in central Copenhagen and already serve customers globally in our vertical, including some of the most demanding names in automotive. We have grown to this point almost entirely on product strength, domain credibility and word of mouth.

The platform now covers more ground than the team that built it. We are hiring engineers to keep that pace sustainable, and to go deeper on the parts of the product our customers are pushing hardest.

The role

You will join a small engineering team and work across the whole stack: Python on the backend, TypeScript on the frontend and in the AI layers. There is no split between people who design and people who implement. You will take a problem from a customer conversation or a product decision through to something running in production for real manufacturers.

You will work directly with our co-founder and CEO, who is a hands-on product builder himself. That means short conversations instead of tickets thrown over a wall, and it means your questions about why something should work a certain way get answered by the person who decided it.

The domain is genuinely complicated, and that is the interesting part. Supplier relationships in automotive involve deep hierarchies, long-running approval processes, strict audit requirements and a lot of state that has to be exactly right. Modeling that well is most of the job.

Title and level flex with experience. We are open to strong mid-level engineers and to senior engineers who want more scope than their current company gives them.

We work together from our office in central Copenhagen. This is primarily an in-office role: at this stage, and on a codebase with this much implicit context, working through problems with the rest of the team in person is much faster than doing it in writing. Sensible flexibility when you need it is a given; full-time remote is not what we are offering.

Our Current Stack

• Backend: Python / Django

• Frontend: Vue (but no specific Vue experience is needed)

• Infrastructure: AWS (mostly)

• Agents: Cloudflare (TypeScript) + Claude & OpenAI platform

What you will do

• Build features end to end, from data model and backend logic through to the TypeScript frontend our customers actually click on.

• Build end-to-end / front-to-back AI features (in-app AI assistants, background worker agents, email-routing agents, customer-configurable agent framework components)

• Design and evolve the relational data model that sits under supplier relationships, approvals and quality records.

• Take vaguely defined customer problems and turn them into something specific enough to build, then build it.

• Work on integrations between Supplios and customer systems (ERP and adjacent tooling), where failures have visible consequences for a production line.

• Improve the parts of the codebase that need it, rather than routing around them.

• Review other people's code and have yours reviewed; we keep the loop tight and unbureaucratic.

• Help keep the platform healthy in production across our regions: errors, performance and the boring things that keep customers trusting us.

• Take part in product decisions. Engineers here are expected to have opinions about what we build, not just how.

What we are looking for

Essential

• Professional experience with Python. This is not negotiable; the backend is Python and you need to be effective in it.

• Solid TypeScript experience and genuine comfort working on the frontend.

• Experience building and running SaaS products, including the part after launch where real users depend on them.

• AI-forward development techniques. (This does not mean you no longer write code.)

• A track record of owning work end to end without waiting to be told what to do next.

• The temperament for a small, senior company: high ownership, low ceremony.

• You want to work primarily from an office in central Copenhagen, with a small team.

Nice to have

Genuinely a plus, not a requirement. Nobody has all of these.

• Experience with B2B enterprise SaaS, especially where customers are large and demanding and implementations are not self-serve. This is a significant plus.

• Experience with complex relational data modeling, and with large, long-lived codebases that you did not write yourself. A big plus.

• Experience building AI-based products, using the latest frameworks/harnesses and infrastructure components (including RAG) is a significant plus.

• Familiarity with any of: domain-driven design, the actor model, finite state machines, CQRS, event-driven architecture. We use these ideas where they earn their place, and it helps if the vocabulary is already yours.

• Startup experience, particularly early stage. A significant plus.

• Knowledge of manufacturing, automotive or supply chain. Useful, but we can teach you the domain; we cannot teach you the craft, so do not rule yourself out on this.

Language

English is the only important language for this position; we work in English, and so do our customers. Danish language skills are not required.

Why this role is worth your time

• The scope is unusually large for the stage. You are one of a small number of engineers on a platform that serves demanding customers globally. What you build ships, and it ships soon.

• No layers between you and the decisions. You work directly with the co-founder and CEO, who runs product. There is no committee to navigate and nobody to translate your work for you.

• Hard problems that are not artificially hard. The complexity comes from the domain (hierarchies, state, audit trails, integrations that must not fail), not from organisational overhead.

• Real customers already, and real gaps. The product has paying customers in automotive and clear places where it needs to get better. Both halves of that are true, and both are why this is a good job.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note on why this role interests you to team@supplios.com. Work examples will help.

**About Flatpay

**Flatpay is not just another payment solution; we're dedicated to innovating the market for payment solutions and financial services in the SME segment with our customer-centric and transparent services.

We've grown into one of the fastest-growing fintech companies out of the Nordics and Denmark's fastest unicorn company. Today, we're more than 2,000 colleagues across Europe, building products that make a real difference for our customers.

We're ambitious, move fast, and like to challenge the status quo - but we also believe work should be fun. We celebrate wins, help each other out, and create an environment where people can do great work while genuinely enjoying the journey.

**About The Role

**Our Point of Sale system serves as the central engine of the business. It streamlines the merchant's entire workflow — from order taking, product and inventory management, to payment processing, reporting, and compliance.

**Some Of The Core Capabilities Include

**

• Product catalogue: Organizes how they manage their products, categories, modifiers and inventory

• Order management: Basket, pricing, discounts, payments and managing tables and long-running orders among groups of customers.

• Hardware integrations to barcode scanners, receipt and kitchen/bar printers and our different Mobile-, Premium- and Basic POS devices. No least manage synchronicity across multiple POS systems at shared locations in realtime.

• Our reporting suite ensures cash management, end-of-day reports, various sales, turnover, staff, tax and compliance reports that enables merchants to optimize their business and comply with local tax regulations.

As our merchants grow, so does the platform. Every new market introduces new payment methods, fiscal requirements and merchant needs. Every new feature increases the depth and complexity of the product. And with our customer base doubling approximately every six months, the demands on scalability, reliability and performance continue to grow.

This is a hands-on engineering role with significant ownership. You'll influence technical direction, contribute to architectural decisions and solve the engineering challenges that come with building one of Europe's fastest-growing commerce platforms.

**What You'll Do

**As a Backend Engineer, you'll contribute far beyond implementation. You'll help shape technical direction while remaining deeply involved in building products. You'll work closely with Product, Design and fellow engineers to build software that scales across all dimensions: more merchants, more markets, more capabilities and increasingly sophisticated workflows.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Designing, building and evolving features across our Point of Sale platform platform.

• Lead feature and platform initiatives involving multiple engineers, driving delivery from discovery through production

• Build APIs, services, and integrations that enable stock, order lifecycle, sales reporting & compliance reporting towards governmental standards of our markets.

• Take ownership of features from design and implementation through deployment and maintenance

• Drive architectural decisions and long-term technical improvements

• Improve reliability, observability, performance, and security across the platform

• Continuously improving our engineering practices, tooling and development experience

• Contribute to testing, operational excellence and contribute to a collaborative team culture

Who you are

We're looking for experienced engineers who enjoy solving difficult problems and helping others succeed.

**You Likely Bring

**

• 2-5 years of professional software engineering experience

• Experience designing and operating distributed systems

• Comfortable working with modern software engineering practices, including testing and version control

• Curious, pragmatic, and eager to learn new technologies

• Strong communication skills and a willingness to take ownership of your work

• A collaborative mindset and a willingness to challenge ideas constructively

• A self-starter that gets your jobs done independently or actively seeks help if needed

• Contribute to testing, operational excellence and contribute to a collaborative team culture

• Experience within payments, fintech, e-commerce, SaaS, or high-scale transaction systems is a plus

You'll be working with the following technologies; we don't expect experience with every technology listed; we're looking for engineers who can learn quickly and help us build great products.

• Java, Spring Boot, JUnit

• MySQL, Flyway, SQS

• REST APIs

• Domain Driven Design

• Docker, Terraform, AWS ECS

• Ports and adapters architecture

**Why Flatpay

DevOps / Platform Engineer — Fully Remote, Performance & Production Ownership

Want to work fully remotely with real freedom and ownership while operating high-throughput, low-latency systems that serve billions of shoppers?

For the right person, this is a high-trust role where you have flexibility in how you structure your work and the opportunity to make a significant impact on the technology behind billions of e-commerce experiences.

We’re building the infrastructure behind better e-commerce experiences for billions of shoppers every year.

Our systems serve more than 2,000 requests per second. Our in-house search engine delivers a p50 latency of sub-ms, while our entire infrastructure maintains 99.998% uptime.

We work with modern technology, use AI as a fundamental part of how we build, and continuously push the limits of reliability, performance, and innovation. Our goal is simple: connect e-commerce shoppers with the right products at the right time while helping merchants create a better customer experience and improve their bottom line.

We’re proud of the systems we’ve built—and we want someone who is excited to help make them even faster, more reliable, and more capable.

This job will be perfect for you if

• You enjoy operating high-throughput production systems where latency, reliability, and customer impact matter

• You care deeply about reliability, latency, throughput, and system performance

• You can investigate problems across infrastructure, application code, databases, queues, and networks

• You are comfortable reading, writing, debugging, and optimising production code

• You proactively identify failure scenarios before they become incidents

• You build automation and tooling instead of accepting repetitive manual work

• You enjoy improving CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, and developer experience

• You have handled serious production incidents and understand the responsibility that comes with on-call

• You think beyond whether a deployment succeeded and care about how the system behaves afterwards

• You can communicate clearly during incidents and take ownership when things matter

• You are curious about new technology and enjoy finding better ways to build and operate systems

• You want to work closely with software engineers rather than treating infrastructure as a separate world

• You thrive in a remote environment where freedom is matched by responsibility

A normal day for you

No two days will be the same, but your work might include:

• Investigating why a service, query, or piece of application code is slower than it should be

• Improving the reliability and performance of systems serving thousands of requests per second

• Reviewing metrics, traces, logs, and alerts to identify issues before they affect customers

• Designing and implementing infrastructure, automation, and internal tooling

• Writing, reviewing, debugging, and optimising production code

• Working with developers to improve how systems are built, deployed, and operated

• Responding to incidents when needed, then making sure the underlying problem is permanently addressed

• Exploring how new technologies and AI-powered tools can improve our engineering workflow

• Thinking proactively about scaling, capacity, resilience, and potential failure scenarios

AI is part of the job

We’re an AI-first company. AI and agentic coding are already part of how we build, investigate, automate, and improve systems.

You should already be comfortable using AI in your daily engineering workflow—for example, to investigate incidents, generate and review code, build internal tooling, automate operational work, and improve your own productivity.

How we work

This role can be fully remote for the right person.

We believe in giving people the freedom to structure their work in a way that helps them perform at their best. We care about impact, ownership, communication, and results—not about watching when or where you work.

You’ll need to work with meaningful overlap during CET working hours and participate in our PagerDuty/on-call rotation. Freedom comes with responsibility, especially when you are responsible for production systems.

On-call includes holidays

If you are scheduled to be on call and a genuine production alarm goes off—whether that is on a normal weekday, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, New Year’s Eve, or New Year’s Day—you are expected to respond, take ownership, and stay with the issue until our systems are fully up and running again.

This is an important part of the role and is not optional. We are looking for someone who genuinely stands behind their work and understands that production ownership sometimes means being there when things go wrong.

At the same time, your goal is to make this situation as rare as possible. The best engineer is not the person who enjoys firefighting every holiday, but the person who builds reliable systems, strong monitoring, and effective automation so that firefighting is never needed.

How to apply

Instead of starting with a traditional cover letter, please send us a maximum 10-minute video.

We are hiring a human being—not AI-generated slop, a spotless resume, or someone who simply knows how to present the right keywords. We know the kind of person we are looking for, but the process also needs to be mutual. You should get the opportunity to meet the people behind the company and decide whether this is the right environment for you.

That is why we want to meet you upfront and see how you think, communicate, and explain your experience—not only evaluate what is written on paper.

**In The Video, Please Tell Us

**

• Who you are

• The production systems you have owned

• A difficult reliability or performance problem you solved

• What you changed and the measurable result

• How you approach incidents and on-call responsibility

• How you currently use AI and agentic coding

• Why you believe you would be a strong fit for this role

• What you are looking for in your next team and role

The video does not need to be polished. Please don’t spend time producing a perfect presentation or reading a script. We want to see the real person, understand how you think, and hear about the work you have actually done.

You may also include a short written example of a system that was slow, unreliable, or difficult to operate. Explain how you found the root cause, what you changed, and what improved afterwards.

If you are primarily an infrastructure administrator, this probably isn’t the right role. If you are a production-minded software engineer who enjoys making systems faster, more reliable, and easier to operate, we would love to hear from you.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like **what we’re saying, keep reading!

****About Otc Core

**In the OTC Core Product Area, we work on functionality supporting over-the-counter financial instruments in SimCorp’s main product, SimCorp Dimension. Our work brings together financial contract modelling, functional programming, and C#/.NET development.

Most of our development work centres on financial contract models written in an internally developed domain-specific language embedded in OCaml. These models bring together business logic, database mapping, and user-interface layout in one place. Alongside implementing the models, we evolve the language itself and the supporting C#/.NET framework.

You do not need to arrive as an expert in OTC instruments or OCaml. What matters is curiosity about the problems, strong programming foundations, and a willingness to learn.

**What You Will Work On

**As part of a cross-functional team working across locations, you will contribute from the first discussion of a feature through design, implementation, testing, and support.

You will:

• Implement financial contract models in our OCaml-based domain-specific language, defining their business logic, database mapping, and user-interface layout.

• Evolve the OCaml-based language and supporting C#/.NET framework, balancing new capabilities with improvements to existing code.

• Use AI-assisted development tools - including Claude, GitHub Copilot, and our internally developed cloud agent - to explore solutions, develop code, and improve tests, applying your engineering judgment to validate the results.

• Work with product management and fellow engineers to understand business needs and turn them into maintainable solutions.

• Build automated tests and use code reviews to improve correctness, clarity, and maintainability.

• Help make technical decisions, address technical debt, and share your experience with colleagues.

**What You Bring

**We are primarily looking for a senior engineer who can work through complex problems, contribute to design decisions, and collaborate effectively with others.

We value:

• Strong programming and software design skills, with experience in C#/.NET or functional programming.

• The ability to understand an existing system and make thoughtful, well-tested changes.

• Curiosity about functional programming, financial modelling, and the business problems behind the code.

• A collaborative approach: asking questions, explaining your reasoning, and giving and receiving constructive feedback.

• Clear communication in English and a willingness to keep learning.

Experience with OCaml or other functional languages (Haskell, Scala, F#, or similar), domain-specific languages, Web APIs, or financial software would be useful - but you do not need to bring all of it. A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience can provide a foundation; we are interested in what you can do and how you approach problems.

**Benefits

**

• Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.

• Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.

• Self- Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.

• Inclusive and diverse company culture.

• Pension and health benefits and bonus.

• Work-life balance - We truly believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of our self's, both in private life and as a colleague in the workplace.

• Empowerment - We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will involved in shaping our work processes.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.
